description: Source code for the Scalar command-line interface, implementing repository management commands such as clone, list, register, unregister, reconfigure, delete, diagnose, and version, with functions for setting configurations, managing enlistments, and running git commands.

methods.name: setup_enlistment_directory
methods.description: Sets up the repository enlistment directory, changing working directory as needed and verifying repository structure.

methods.name: run_git
methods.description: Executes a git command with variable arguments.

methods.name: set_scalar_config
methods.description: Sets a scalar configuration key to a specified value.

methods.name: set_config_if_missing
methods.description: Sets configuration if missing or reconfiguration is requested.

methods.name: have_fsmonitor_support
methods.description: Checks if fsmonitor support is available.

methods.name: set_recommended_config
methods.description: Sets recommended configuration options for the repository.

methods.name: toggle_maintenance
methods.description: Enables or disables maintenance mode.

methods.name: add_or_remove_enlistment
methods.description: Adds or removes a repository enlistment in global git config.

methods.name: start_fsmonitor_daemon
methods.description: Starts the fsmonitor daemon if supported.

methods.name: stop_fsmonitor_daemon
methods.description: Stops the fsmonitor daemon if running.

methods.name: register_dir
methods.description: Registers the current directory as a Scalar enlistment and sets configuration.

methods.name: unregister_dir
methods.description: Unregisters the current directory as a Scalar enlistment.

methods.name: delete_enlistment
methods.description: Deletes an enlistment directory after unregistering.

methods.name: load_builtin_commands
methods.description: Dummy function to satisfy linking; not implemented.

methods.name: cmd_clone
methods.description: Handles the 'clone' command for Scalar, cloning repositories and setting up configuration.

methods.name: cmd_diagnose
methods.description: Runs diagnostics on the enlistment.

methods.name: cmd_list
methods.description: Lists registered Scalar repositories.

methods.name: cmd_register
methods.description: Registers the current directory as a Scalar enlistment.

methods.name: cmd_reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures registered enlistments, updating settings.

methods.name: cmd_run
methods.description: Runs specific maintenance tasks.

methods.name: cmd_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a Scalar enlistment.

methods.name: cmd_delete
methods.description: Deletes an enlistment directory.

methods.name: cmd_help
methods.description: Displays help information.

methods.name: cmd_version
methods.description: Displays version information.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point parsing command-line arguments and dispatching commands.
